description: The bar chart illustrates the quality scores of three categories, IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, with each category represented by a grouped set of bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Scores" and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Each category has three bars: a gray bar representing "Base Avgsin", a blue bar representing "Avgeq", and a pink bar representing "Avgsup". The "Avgeq" bars have values of 63.98, 66.06, and 67.64 for IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, respectively, while the "Avgsup" bars have values of 41.90, 39.13, and 42.99. The "Base Avgsin" values are represented by dashed lines, with values of approximately 39 and 64.71 for the lower and upper lines, respectively. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Avgeq" bars being the tallest in each group, and the categories are not sorted in any particular order. The chart provides a visual representation of the quality scores for each category, allowing for a comparison of the scores across the different categories.
